scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy -c dist/worker/wrangler.json && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote -c dist/worker/wrangler.json

OWNER_SETUP_TOKEN.description: Recommended first-run path. Generate a unique code with `openssl rand -hex 32`, set it as a Worker secret, then open the control panel to choose a stored owner password. Required only until setup is complete.

OWNER_PASSWORD.description: Alternative to first-run setup: set a long, unique owner password as a Worker secret. If both owner secrets exist, this password takes precedence.

INTEGRATION_TOKEN.description: Optional separate bearer token for server-side game adapters publishing normalized events. Do not put it in browser code or overlay URLs.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Enables AI parsing of viewer challenge suggestions; the deterministic fallback works without it.
